programme.name: Global CRM Transformation
programme.goal: Build a global commercial operating model that reduces administrative work, improves lead conversion, gives leadership trustworthy data, and connects sales activity to customer value.
programme.primary_objective: Reduce manual administration so employees can spend more time finding qualified leads, building relationships, and closing deals.
programme.supporting_objectives: Improve data reliability, forecasting, customer handoffs, onboarding, and measurable customer outcomes.

workflows.intro: Eight stages from the first marketing interaction to renewal, expansion and advocacy. Each stage has an accountable owner, required information, a measurable exit condition and a defined next step.

workflows.name: Stage gates & SLAs
workflows.intro: A stage is a verifiable state of the customer relationship, not a label. Automations flag overdue work and prompt people to act. They never mark an opportunity lost because a timer expired.

workflows.intro: One globally consistent data model. Integrations reduce manual work; they must not create duplicates or conflicting sources of truth. Example rules are illustrative, not assumptions about current systems.

workflows.name: Governance & change control
workflows.intro: Governance matches the risk of the change. System ownership (RevOps) is separate from business process ownership. Consultation is shared; decision rights are explicit.
